``` ::: ::: # Summary Statistics: Central Tendency ## Mean * Sum number of observation in groups, $\sum{n_iS_i}$ * The total number of vehicle, $N$ * * mean, $\bar{x} = \frac{\sum{n_iS_i}}{N}$ - $N = 368$ - $\sum{n_iS_i} = 1.7736\times 10^{4}$ - $\bar{x} = \frac{1.7736\times 10^{4}}{368} = 48.2$ mph ## Meadian * speed that divides the distribution into equal parts - there are as many observations of speeds higher than the median as there are lower than the median * $N/2=368/2=184$ th observation divides the data into equal parts * or, the speed at which $50%$ cumulative frequency is found * From the table, $P_{50} = 47$ mph ## Mode * Speed at which max observation occurs * From Table: max observation is $65$ at speed $47$ mph * Mode: $47$ mph ## Low Speed and High Speed * Speed at which 15% drivers are driving * From Table: 15% occurs between speed $41$ and $43$ mph; mean $42$ mph * From the table, $P_{15} = 42$ mph * Speed at which 85% drivers are driving * From Table: 85% occurs between speed $53$ and $55$ mph; mean $54$ mph * From the table, $P_{85} = 54$ mph ## Graphical Approach: Median, Mode, Pace ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ch11spdDataAnalysis_files/figure-html/hist graph-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ch11spdDataAnalysis_files/figure-html/freq dist graph-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ch11spdDataAnalysis_files/figure-html/pdf graph-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ch11spdDataAnalysis_files/figure-html/cumul freq dist graph-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: # Summary Statistics: Dispersion
